newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bonds hold firm,gets date on wage claim.
newsitem.headline: Australian bonds hold firm,gets date on wage claim.

text.p: *Australian bond yields ended only just above 1-1/2 month lows as the market continued to build-in the best case scenario for upcoming data.
*"Living wage" claim result due next Tuesday.
Australian bond yields ended only just above 1-1/2 month lows as the market continued to build in the best case scenario for upcoming data.

The market again saw a burst of activity on the futures floor at the opening, which was largely due to U.S. hedge fund accounts, continuing the recent steep rally on the premise that inflation and wages data in the next few weeks.

The market was also relieved that the Australian Industrial Relations Commission had finally set a date for its verdict on the "living wage" claim for next Tuesday after having waited weeks for a decision.
